body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> AERIAL7 unveiled the 'ROYALE BOURBON', a luxury stereo headphone at 2011 CES Unveiled.

The Royale headphone by AERIAL7 is a luxury stereo headphone crafted from only the finest materials. From its soft, full grain leather ear cushions and headband to it's premium quality speakers, the Royale delivers unparalleled sound reproduction satisfying even the most acute listeners.
•Engineered to deliver the highest-quality listening experience from your Apple iPod®, iPhone®, BlackBerry®, or other mp3 player, cell phone or music device.
•1m DJ coiled cable extends easily to 2.5m
•1.2m lightweight cable with mic for iPhone®, Blackberry®, Skype™ & MP3
